name.es: Papel foil (aluminio sobre papel de seda)
name.fr: Papier aluminium contrecollé (sur papier de soie)
name.pt: Papel laminado (alumínio sobre papel de seda)

crease_length_scale_t.basis: hand crease scale as for paper; the foil sets almost fully [E]

crease_set_rate.basis: near-zero springback: the rest angle follows the pressed angle (rsE §b)

provenance.author: Innovaciones MADFAM
sources: Pliego research memo rsE (2026-10-10) §b material default table — engineering estimates [E] unless a source is cited
Lechenault, Thiria & Adda-Bedia 2014, Mechanical response of a creased sheet, PRL 112, 244301 — https://arxiv.org/abs/1404.1243

areal_density_kg_m2.basis: derived.areal_density (g/mm²) × 1000; physical.gsm estimated: ≈ 60–70 g/m²: aluminium 7–9 µm on tissue (rsE §b)

E1t.basis: derived.E_md × t; physical.E_md_gpa estimated: effective 3–8 GPa laminate (rsE §b) [E]; physical.caliper_um estimated: rsE §b

E2t.basis: derived.E_cd × t; physical.E_cd_gpa estimated: aluminium is near-isotropic in-plane (rsE §b) [E]; physical.caliper_um estimated: rsE §b

G12t.basis: derived.G12 × t, G12 = 0.387·√(E_md·E_cd) (Baum, Brennan & Habeger 1981, via pliego.stock.derive v1)

nu12.basis: ν12 = ν·√(E_md/E_cd): the card's ν is the geometric mean √(ν12·ν21), split by reciprocity ν12/E1 = ν21/E2; physical.nu estimated: laminate dominated by aluminium [E]

D11.basis: derived.D_md × 1e-9 (N·m), plate E·t³/(12(1−ν²)) in pliego.stock.derive v1; physical.E_md_gpa estimated: effective 3–8 GPa laminate (rsE §b) [E]; physical.nu estimated: laminate dominated by aluminium [E]; physical.caliper_um estimated: rsE §b

D22.basis: derived.D_cd × 1e-9 (N·m), plate E·t³/(12(1−ν²)) in pliego.stock.derive v1; physical.E_cd_gpa estimated: aluminium is near-isotropic in-plane (rsE §b) [E]; physical.nu estimated: laminate dominated by aluminium [E]; physical.caliper_um estimated: rsE §b

D66.basis: G12·t³/12 with the estimated G12 above

crease_length_scale_t.basis: physical.crease_length_scale_t estimated: hand crease scale as for paper; the foil sets almost fully [E]

crease_yield_deg.basis: physical.crease_yield_deg estimated: aluminium yields almost immediately: θ_y → 0 (rsE §b)

crease_set_rate.basis: physical.crease_set_rate estimated: near-zero springback: the rest angle follows the pressed angle (rsE §b)

score_factor.basis: pliego.stock.derive v1 default (card has no physical.score_factor)

notes: friction: the card states one paper-on-paper coefficient; it is written as friction_static, and friction_kinetic and damping are left out rather than invented
